purpose: Localize every table-cell transition in the unchanged initial Gate F candidate and determine whether the observed seam cases are compatible with an explicit one-sided piecewise transition route rather than timestep retuning or derivative averaging.

frozen_candidate.hydraulic_table: unchanged qualified C1R N241 float32 bilinear log-mobility
frozen_candidate.jacobian_policy: always assembled from the strict interpolation cells occupied by the accepted start state; never averaged across a node

scope.reason: These are the only cases that produced any table-cell transition in the frozen 108-case Gate F execution.

required_localization: accepted step index and start/end time
start and end N241 cell index
exact crossed node index and node pressure head when displacement magnitude is one
whether multiple state components cross in one trial
whether any component crosses more than one node in one trial
mass, domain, envelope and nonfinite diagnostics for the crossing trial

route_hypothesis.name: EXPLICIT_ONE_SIDED_START_CELL_TRANSITION_ROUTE
route_hypothesis.meaning: A trial that starts in a qualified strict interpolation cell may finish in the adjacent cell while using only the qualified one-sided start-cell derivative for that trial. The transition is an explicit runtime branch, not a smooth tangent claim. The next accepted step reassembles from the new cell.

predeclared_admissibility_signals.temporal_accuracy_is_not_rejudged_or_rel: use the already frozen Gate F thresholds and evidence

fail_closed_conditions: any component jumps over more than one table node in one trial
mass residual above the frozen Gate F hard threshold
evidence that a cross-node derivative was averaged or invented
explicit_nonclaims: R0 does not yet qualify a production seam route.
R0 does not change the original Gate F FAIL into PASS.
R0 does not qualify saturation, heterogeneity, groundwater, H_ENPR or KSATEXM.
R0 does not select a smaller timestep after seeing O14.
